SELECT todo.bookset_id as booksetId, todo.happen_date as happenDate, todo.book_date as bookDate, todo.bookset_date as booksetDate, bok.standard_ccy as standardCcy, todo.task_id as taskId, ext.param_code as paramCode, ext.param_value as carryoverCycle, bok.acct_subject_id as acctSubjectId, bok.acct_subject_type as acctSubjectType, bok.end_date as endDate, lay.mdate as mdate, bdi.bok_detail_id as bokDetailId FROM (SELECT bookset_id, happen_date, book_date, bookset_date, task_id FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO WHERE SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} GROUP BY bookset_id, happen_date, book_date, bookset_date, task_id) todo LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok ON todo.bookset_id = bok.bookset_id left join BOK_BOOKSET_DATE bbd on todo.bookset_id = bbd.bookset_id left join bok_detail_id bdi on bok.bookset_id = bdi.bookset_id and bok.acct_subject_id = bdi.busi_id and bok.acct_subject_type = bdi.busi_detail_type LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO lay ON bok.acct_subject_id = lay.busi_id AND lay.bookset_id = bok.bookset_id AND bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = lay.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_ext ext ON bok.bookset_id = ext.bookset_id AND ext.param_code = #{carryoverCycle}
AND bok.BOK_SPEC_MODE = #{bokSpecMode}

select curr.bok_detail_id as bokDetailId, curr.subject_no as subjectNo, curr.o_ccy as oCcy, SUM(curr.o_happen_amt * DECODE(curr.cd_flag, 'C', 1, 0)) as cInterBalance, SUM(curr.o_happen_amt * DECODE(curr.cd_flag, 'D', 1, 0)) as dInterBalance from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT curr where curr.bookset_id = #{booksetId} and curr.happen_date > #{preDate} and curr.happen_date <= #{happenDate} group by curr.bok_detail_id, curr.subject_no, curr.o_ccy
